purpose: One flat grid of internal link cards. The site's universal listing primitive.

items.maxItemsBasis: the largest real grid is the 35-item /employee-recognition-messages index, recomputed from data

geometry: ul.flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-[3em]; cards 42em; 2 columns at 1280

constraints.maxPerPageBasis: T-DETAIL-VALUES carries 3; T-PILLAR's reading list carries 8 plus 2 inline groups. 10 is the real observed ceiling.
constraints.note: This section legitimately repeats many times on one page. Every structural rule about it MUST key on (section, variant/headingLevel), never on the bare section id.

motion.RULE: ZERO animation. No whileInView, no stagger, no per-card delay, no entrance. Cards are static from first paint. DO NOT ADD ANY.

motionClosureScope: CLOSED for PageSpec emission: a generated node's `motion` object may contain ONLY the fields in motionFieldSet, enforced by schema/pagespec.schema.json (additionalProperties:false) and the MOTION_OBJECT_IS_CLOSED rule. The keys in motionDocumentationFields below are contract-level documentation carried by THIS file for human and retrieval use; they are NOT settable on a PageSpec node.
